name: Shin'yuu no Haha o Me no Mae de Nakadashi Choukyou ~Oba-san, Do-M Desho?~
original_name: 親友の母を目の前で中出し調教～オバサン、ドMでしょ？～
source:
Keiko Hiraoka was an unsatisfied mother and wife.
Her son had a friend named Yuto. He came and went like part of the family.
One day he came to Keiko with a very different motive... 

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE069805.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
平冈惠子是一位不满足的母亲和妻子。
她的儿子有一个朋友，名叫佑斗。他来来去去就像家庭的一部分。
有一天，他带着完全不同的动机来到惠子身边…… 

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE069805.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
